_comment: VoiceSession placement: one live single-operator session task. Persistence: only minimized session metadata through EventLedger; raw input remains processing-only. Concurrency: one session task and one active PersonaPlex lock.

_ignores.start: the session is already active; duplicate start is idempotent and ignored
a degraded session cannot be restarted as a new session
_ignores.degrade: the session is already degraded; repeated dependency failure is recorded by observability
